description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Veigar''' casts down a mass of dark matter that strikes the target location after a 1.221 seconds delay, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area during the delay and afterwards dealing magic damage to enemies hit.
description.text: Active: Veigar casts down a mass of dark matter that strikes the target location after a 1.221 seconds delay, granting sight of the area during the delay and afterwards dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

description2.raw: ''Dark Matter's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced based on stacks of ''[[File:Veigar Phenomenal Evil Power.png|20xpx|border|link=Veigar#Phenomenal Evil Power|An icon for Veigar's ability Phenomenal Evil Power]] [[Veigar#Phenomenal Evil Power|Phenomenal Evil]]''.
description2.text: Dark Matter's  cooldown is reduced based on stacks of Phenomenal Evil.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
85 / 140 / 195 / 250 / 305 (+ 70 / 80 / 90 / 100 / 110% AP)

notes.raw:
* The delay starts at the beginning of the cast time.
** If '''Veigar''' dies during the cast time, ''Dark Matter'' will still successfully fall from the sky.
